app.name: Kindred
app.tagline: An AI agent for finding the person you're looking for.

chat.empty_title: Describe the person you're looking for.
chat.empty_hint: Be specific or vague — the agent works with either. It searches profiles, narrows down, and shows a few candidates per turn.
examples: Someone quiet who reads on rainy afternoons
A funny architect who walks everywhere
chat.placeholder_followup: Refine your search, or ask for more
chat.disclaimer: All profiles are mock data. Nothing leaves your browser.

agent.narrow_hint: Want to narrow this down? Try saying "younger", "closer to me", or "more into the outdoors" — or click a filter below to remove it.
agent.no_more: No more matches in the index. Try changing direction — a different trait, mood, or city.
agent.insight_no_shared: {{name}} doesn't match a specific trait you mentioned — but the agent thought you should see them.
agent.after_focus: Want to see more people like them, or keep looking around?
agent.compare_invite: You've saved {{count}}. Want me to help you compare them side by side?

saved.title: Saved profiles
saved.empty: Nothing saved yet. Save a profile from a search result and it'll appear here.
saved.compare_hint: You've saved {{count}}. Open them side by side to decide who to reach out to first.

compare.title: Compare saved
compare.empty: Save at least two people to compare.
compare.agent_note: Use the differences to pick who you want to reach out to first. Reaching out is the last small step.
compare.reach_out_toast: In the real product, this would open a conversation with {{name}}.

canvas.title: Shortlist
canvas.empty_hint: Describe someone in the chat. The agent searches the index and surfaces candidates on this canvas.

notfound.title: Not found
notfound.body: That profile isn't in the index.
